##### Project general facts

Bab Al Bahr Residences is an exclusive waterfront residential community on Al Marjan Island, inspired by the timeless beauty of traditional Arabic architecture and the serenity of coastal living. Comprising the elegant Fayrouz, Kahraman, and Yakout buildings, the development offers a distinctive collection of apartments and penthouses where contemporary comfort meets the charm of island-inspired design. Its iconic pyramid-shaped architecture creates a striking silhouette against the shoreline, making Bab Al Bahr a landmark destination for those seeking an exceptional seaside lifestyle.

Life at Bab Al Bahr is centered around the beauty of the Arabian Gulf, offering residents direct access to pristine white sandy beaches and uninterrupted panoramic sea views. Designed to embrace the relaxed rhythm of island living, the community provides a peaceful atmosphere where nature, open spaces, and the waterfront become part of everyday life. The low-rise design enhances the sense of privacy and exclusivity, creating a tranquil retreat that perfectly balances luxury with effortless coastal elegance.

The residences are crafted to the highest standards, featuring premium finishes, quality fittings, and thoughtfully designed interiors that maximize natural light and showcase the surrounding views. Spacious layouts and equipped kitchens provide both functionality and comfort, while the overall design reflects a refined yet understated aesthetic inspired by the project's unique waterfront setting. Bab Al Bahr Residences offers a timeless living experience where sophisticated design and the beauty of the sea come together in perfect harmony.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Al Marjan Island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts, offering world-class amenities and services. These accommodations cater to both leisure and business travelers, providing a range of options to suit different preferences and budgets. Many of the hotels and resorts on the island feature stunning architecture and provide access to private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options.
